_about: AI-1r triage, read handler by handler on 2026-10-03. Checked by coverage.py on every run: a row whose handler or tool is gone, that is now covered by name, or that has no reason, fails the scan. See SKILL.md.

getProjects.reason: Both list every Demo Builder project on disk; the tool also marks the current one.

requestStatus.reason: Same derivation (dashboardStatusService); the handler pushes it to the dashboard, the tool returns it.

republishContent.reason: Both call republishStorefrontContent (DA.live pages to the CDN). NOT `republish`, which regenerates and publishes config.json only.

exportProject.reason: Same file from the same function (createExportSettings); the tool writes for the current project, which set_current_project picks.

import-storefront-zip.reason: add_shared_demo with zipPath runs the same zip-to-repository import (readStorefrontZip + the handler's own refusal check).

configure.reason: The handler only runs the demoBuilder.configureProject command; open_view with view=configure runs the same command.

authenticate.reason: Adobe browser sign-in through the same authManager.login(); the tool does not pass force.

reAuthenticate.reason: Adobe browser sign-in. The handler also restores the project's org context afterwards; agent tools carry that per call (runWithAdobeTarget).

check-auth.reason: Adobe authentication status, without the wizard's progress pushes.

check-dalive-auth.reason: DA.live authentication status and the pinned namespace.

check-github-auth.reason: GitHub authentication status with the user and their orgs.

switchOrg.reason: An agent names the org by id and tools run under that target; the forced browser chooser is how a person changes org. ORG_MISMATCH answers point the agent at select_org or sign_in.

get-projects.reason: Adobe Console projects in the selected org, through the same authManager.getProjects.

get-workspaces.reason: Workspaces of the selected Adobe project.

list-org-console-apis.reason: The org's subscribable Adobe services with which are already covered; the wizard variant only adds in-flight picks that exist in the webview.

ensure-mesh-api-subscribed.reason: The mesh deploy core (deployMeshHeadless) subscribes the API Mesh API itself before deploying; add_console_apis subscribes any other API.

checkCompatibility.reason: The tool dispatches this handler itself (through a local run helper the scan cannot follow).

loadDependencies.reason: The tool dispatches this handler itself (through a local run helper the scan cannot follow).

validateSelection.reason: The tool dispatches this handler itself (through a local run helper the scan cannot follow).

get-components-data.reason: The tool was first written as a row over this handler, then narrowed to one component; list_components gives the ids.

getErpDemoControls.reason: The handler is a GET of the ERP's health route (appearance and downtime); set_erp_appearance's description tells the agent to read it with run_erp_rest on 'health'.

log.reason: The webview writing its own log lines to the extension's logger. Channel plumbing.

ready.reason: The wizard webview announcing it has loaded. Channel plumbing.

answerOperationPrompt.reason: The progress modal handing back the button the SC pressed. An agent answers through confirm:true on the tool.

getOperationProgress.reason: A reopened progress modal asking where its operation got to, and taking it back from the notification. Modal plumbing.

validate.reason: Validates one wizard form field and PUSHES the verdict to the webview; the return value carries no outcome.

continue-prerequisites.reason: Resumes the wizard's own check loop from an index held in shared state. An agent uses check_prerequisites and install_prerequisite.

re-detect-context.reason: Clears org caches and re-reads them for the wizard's display after a sign-in outside the app. Agent tools carry their org target on every call.

store-dalive-token-with-org.reason: Takes a pasted DA.live credential. An agent must never carry one; connect_dalive hands the paste to the user.

storefront-setup-cancel.reason: Aborts the wizard's in-flight storefront setup through its own AbortController, behind a modal confirmation. An agent undoes with delete_github_repo and cleanup_dalive_site.

prepareSetupChecks.reason: Signs in to Commerce early so the setup guide's first check is fast. check_setup_steps signs in itself.

provision-accs-credentials.reason: Creates a credential in the user's Console workspace. Kept panel-only on purpose; the handler's own comment says never in the MCP maps.

use-bundle-setup.reason: Closes the wizard and reopens it pre-filled from a bundle's setup. UI navigation; the job behind it is the importFromFile gap.

importFromFile.reason: No tool starts a project from an exported project file. The handler opens a file picker; a path-taking variant is what an agent would need. (A zip bundle's storefront is covered by add_shared_demo.)

resetProject.reason: Only an Edge Delivery project can be reset by an agent (reset_eds_project). A headless project's reset (component re-clone) has no tool.

check-credential-service.reason: No tool asks whether the shared credential service serves this org; only the Diagnostics command and the Commerce step do.

clear-dalive-auth.reason: No tool signs out of DA.live. Whether an agent should be able to is an owner decision.

github-change-account.reason: No tool switches the GitHub account (clear the token, force a fresh sign-in). sign_in covers signing in, not changing who.

getErpOwnershipOptions.reason: add_erp asks the agent to offer the user an ownership rule, and no tool reads the options the dialog shows (which websites and sources are still unowned).
